arguments.cmd:
cd /work && python - <<'EOF'
src = open('model.scad').read()
# cap_bot line + new cap_top line: keep, but also fix the stale comment on cap1_bot line if needed (fine)
# Widen pin cap overhang boxes in z to cover the 45deg cone flank (up to cap top)
old = '''["pin cap underside gear1", [[x1 - 5, y_c - 5, cap1_bot - 0.4], [x1 + 5, y_c + 5, cap1_bot + 0.4]]]'''
new = '''["pin cap underside gear1", [[x1 - 5.2, y_c - 5.2, cap1_bot - 0.4], [x1 + 5.2, y_c + 5.2, cap1_bot + cap_h + 0.4]]]'''
print("cap1:", src.count(old))
src = src.replace(old, new)
for i in [2,3,4]:
    old = '''["pin cap underside gear%d", [[x%d - 5, y_c - 5, cap_bot - 0.4], [x%d + 5, y_c + 5, cap_bot + 0.4]]]''' % (i,i,i)
    new = '''["pin cap underside gear%d", [[x%d - 5.2, y_c - 5.2, cap_bot - 0.4], [x%d + 5.2, y_c + 5.2, cap_top + 0.4]]]''' % (i,i,i)
    print(f"cap{i}:", src.count(old))
    src = src.replace(old, new)
open('model.scad','w').write(src)
print("done")
EOF
grep -n "pin cap underside" /work/model.scad
